title: Electronic and magnetic properties of GeP monolayer modulated by Ge vacancies and doping with Mn and Fe transition metals
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1020-1032
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05770H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hoang Van Ngoc, Vo Van On, Huynh Thi Phuong Thuy, J. Guerrero-Sanchez, D. M. Hoat
A GeP monolayer with a double-layer hexagonal structure with good stability has been predicted. Further, doping- and vacancy-assisted magnetism engineering of the GeP monolayer is investigated towards spintronic applications.
